laravel.explanation: Published endpoint belongs to web1; code executes in the container owned by web2. Port 81 is a graph-level published endpoint, not the container listen port.

observed_local.reason_http_not_verified: PC1 network services are unreachable from host and DC in the local deployment.

abstractions.detail: Redis unauthenticated file write plus SSH root login is represented by one initial capability rule.
The frozen container escape rule concludes host root; host filesystem access, ubuntu SSH and CVE-2021-3493 are not separate reachable stages.
Two explicitly synthetic winrm service-category facts reuse the legacy credentialed execution rule over the observed tcp/445 endpoint. This does not assert real WinRM or exact PsExec semantics.

Frozen disableFirewall rule lacks a credential prerequisite; the generated graph must disclose this shortcut. Closed on the v2 line in D32-h: rules5_v2.P RULE 12 was changed in place to require getAccount/hasAccount, and the case was registered as disable_firewall_credentialed.
OA authentication, upload and inclusion are one registered command-interpreter action; tool-level stages are not individually represented.
